def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
            return [[3 if grid[r][j] == grid[r][c+1+j] else 4 for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
            return [[3 if grid[i][c] == grid[r+1+i][c] else 4 for c in range(w)] for i in range(r)]
    raise ValueError('No centered full separator')

program_path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u099/system/state/workspace/programs/task-97fecca1.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c > 0 and w - c - 1 == c:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            common = {value for row in left for value in row} & {value for row in right for value in row}
            base = next(iter(common))
            return [[3 if left[r][j] == right[r][j] else base for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        if all(value == grid[r][0] for value in grid[r]) and r > 0 and h - r - 1 == r:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            common = {value for row in top for value in row} & {value for row in bottom for value in row}
            base = next(iter(common))
            return [[3 if top[i][c] == bottom[i][c] else base for c in range(w)] for i in range(r)]
    raise ValueError("No centered full separator")
'''
